function.name: calculator
function.description: Evaluate an arithmetic expression exactly and return the result. Use it for any arithmetic beyond trivial; never do multi-step maths in your head. Supports + - * / ** ( ), sqrt(), ln(), log10(), exp(), abs(), min(), max(), round(x, n).

function.name: get_price
function.description: Get the live price and 24h change of a coin or token (Hyperliquid, falling back to Binance). Always call this before stating a current price; never invent prices.

function.name: get_balances
function.description: Get the user's wallet holdings: a list of {symbol, chain, amount, usd}. Optionally filter to one chain.

function.name: hyperliquid_account
function.description: Get the user's Hyperliquid account: account value, margin used, available USDC, open positions (coin, side, size, entry, liquidation price, unrealised pnl, leverage) and open orders.

function.name: position_math
function.description: Compute a perp position's margin, liquidation price, and (if price is given) pnl and ROE.

price.description: Optional current or target price, for pnl and ROE.

maintenance_margin.description: Optional maintenance margin as a fraction, e.g. 0.005 for 0.5%. Defaults to 0.

function.name: search_markets
function.description: Search markets (perps, spot pairs, pools) matching a query. Returns name, type, price, funding (perps) and APY (pools).

query.description: Free text, e.g. 'SOL perp', 'PEPE', 'ETH USDC pool'.

function.name: get_yields
function.description: Get the top yield pools: protocol, chain, asset, apy, tvl. Optionally filter by asset and/or chain.

function.name: prepare_trade
function.description: Prepare a Hyperliquid perp order and open the app's review screen. The user approves it with Face ID; nothing is executed by this call. Never say the trade happened; say it is prepared for review.

function.name: prepare_swap
function.description: Prepare a swap or bridge (through NEAR Intents) and open the Swap/Bridge review screen for the user to approve. Nothing is executed by this call.

function.name: prepare_send
function.description: Prepare a transfer and open the Send review screen for the user to approve. Copy the address character for character (keep EVM checksum case and base58 case).

function.name: open_add_funds
function.description: Open the Add funds flow (deposit QR code and network choice) for the wallet or for Hyperliquid.

function.name: get_quote
function.description: Get a live NEAR Intents (1Click) quote for a swap or bridge without preparing anything: amount out, dollar values, fee and time. Chains: ethereum, base, arbitrum, bsc, polygon, monad, solana, near, bitcoin (destination only), hyperliquid (USDC destination only).

function.name: prepare_multisend
function.description: Prepare one token transfer to many addresses (a list or a spreadsheet of address and amount) and open the Batch send review for the user to approve. Nothing is executed by this call.

function.name: prepare_deposit
function.description: Prepare a deposit into a yield pool (Aave v3 on Ethereum, Base or Arbitrum) and open the Deposit review for the user to approve. Nothing is executed by this call.

function.name: prepare_withdraw
function.description: Prepare a withdrawal from the user's Aave v3 deposit and open the review for the user to approve. Leave amount out to withdraw all. Nothing is executed by this call.

function.name: prepare_buy
function.description: Prepare a buy of a Solana token with USDC or SOL through Jupiter and open the Buy review for the user to approve. Only Jupiter-verified tokens. Nothing is executed by this call.

amount_usd.description: How much to spend, in US dollars.

pay_with.description: Optional. What to pay with. Leave out unless the user said; the app uses USDC if held, else SOL.

function.name: prepare_close
function.description: Prepare closing an open Hyperliquid position, fully or by percent (market, reduce only), and open the Close review for the user to approve. Nothing is executed by this call.

coin.description: Ticker of the open position, e.g. 'SOL'.

percent.description: Optional. Share of the position to close, 1 to 100. Leave out to close all of it.

function.name: get_activity
function.description: Get the user's recent wallet activity: sends, swaps and buys with status (confirmed, failed or in progress), newest first, and how many are in progress. Use it to check whether something happened.

limit.description: Optional. How many rows to return, newest first. Defaults to 10.

function.name: open_app
function.description: Open a site or dApp in Hermit's browser, by name (e.g. 'Uniswap', 'Aave') or by url. Nothing connects to the wallet until the user approves it.

name.description: Name of a dApp or site, e.g. 'Uniswap'.

url.description: A full web address, e.g. 'https://app.uniswap.org'. Use this when the user gave one.
